name: IID/token-frequency baseline
parameterization: categorical distribution over observed TOKEN types + one shared unseen-mass parameter
training_algorithm: closed-form frequency counting + smoothing constant selected on VALIDATION
generation_algorithm: draw TOKENs i.i.d. from the fitted categorical
deterministic_seed_behavior: one PRNG stream, seeded per GRAMMAR_SEED_CONTRACT, consumed in TOKEN-generation order
failure_conditions: NUMERICALLY_UNSTABLE (smoothing underflow); HELDOUT_DEGENERATE (undefined held-out perplexity without smoothing)

name: Character/glyph n-gram
inputs: GLYPH sequence within TOKEN, with explicit start/end symbols
accessible_context: preceding (n-1) GLYPHs within the same TOKEN
parameterization: order-n Markov transition table over GLYPH alphabet + boundary symbols
training_algorithm: MLE counts + smoothing (Kneser-Ney or additive) on DEVELOPMENT; order selected on VALIDATION
generation_algorithm: sample GLYPHs sequentially until end symbol
complexity_measure: free transition parameters = (effective realized contexts) x (|alphabet|-1)
failure_conditions: COMPLEXITY_UNBOUNDED (n grows without smoothing control); MEMORIZATION_DOMINATED (n approaches max TOKEN length)

name: Variable-order Markov (glyph-level)
accessible_context: variable-length GLYPH history within TOKEN, back-off bounded by a frozen max depth
training_algorithm: incremental context-tree construction + back-off fitting on DEVELOPMENT; depth/penalty selected on VALIDATION
hyperparameter_space: max depth; back-off penalty / escape probability
generation_algorithm: sample via the fitted back-off tree
complexity_measure: number of realized context-tree nodes (or its MDL-coded size)
failure_conditions: NUMERICALLY_UNSTABLE (degenerate escape probabilities); COMPLEXITY_UNBOUNDED (unpenalized tree growth)

name: Finite-state formation grammar (deterministic)
parameterization: finite-state automaton (states, GLYPH-labeled transitions, accept states) via state-merging induction
training_algorithm: state-merging induction on DEVELOPMENT; merging-significance threshold selected on VALIDATION
generation_algorithm: deterministic given a state path; TOKEN-level stochastic choice requires a frozen tie-break rule or pairing with M4
deterministic_seed_behavior: one PRNG stream, used only for frozen tie-breaking
failure_conditions: NON_GENERATIVE (accepts a TOKEN set but defines no probability without a tie-break rule); TRAINING_FAILED (merging does not converge under the frozen threshold)

name: Probabilistic finite-state grammar
parameterization: PFSA: states with GLYPH-labeled probabilistic transitions
training_algorithm: state-merging induction + frequency/EM transition-probability fitting on DEVELOPMENT; states/threshold selected on VALIDATION
failure_conditions: NUMERICALLY_UNSTABLE (near-zero transition probabilities); HELDOUT_DEGENERATE (many held-out TOKENs rejected/zero-probability)

name: Component/rule formation grammar
parameterization: explicit rule set decomposing a TOKEN into a COMPONENT sequence from per-slot COMPONENT inventories, with a probability per rule/slot choice
training_algorithm: rule induction (frequent-COMPONENT mining + slot-grammar fitting) on DEVELOPMENT; slot count/min support selected on VALIDATION
hyperparameter_space: number of slots; minimum rule support; per-slot inventory-size cap
generation_algorithm: sample a rule/slot sequence, concatenate COMPONENTs
complexity_measure: number of rules + total COMPONENT-inventory size across slots (lexicon/exception cost applies directly, GRAMMAR_COMPLEXITY_CONTRACT.md)
failure_conditions: MEMORIZATION_DOMINATED (induced rule set approaches one rule per observed TOKEN)

name: Contextual token model
inputs: TOKEN sequence, built on a frozen G1 (Nested Model Principle, task85 section 9)
accessible_context: bounded window of preceding TOKENs (following TOKENs only if the discovery protocol licenses it); never LINE/PAGE/FOLIO identity
parameterization: smoothed TOKEN n-gram/Markov model, backing off to the frozen G1 for unseen TOKENs
training_algorithm: MLE + smoothing on DEVELOPMENT; order and back-off policy selected on VALIDATION
hyperparameter_space: TOKEN-context order; back-off smoothing constant; G1 back-off weight
generation_algorithm: sample TOKENs sequentially, drawing from G1 on back-off
complexity_measure: realized TOKEN n-gram parameters, reported plus (not merged with) inherited G1 complexity
failure_conditions: MEMORIZATION_DOMINATED (order approaches corpus-unique n-grams); COMPLEXITY_UNBOUNDED (no back-off penalty)

name: Hierarchical/state-conditioned model
inputs: TOKEN sequence + STRUCTURAL_STATE, built on a frozen G1+G2
accessible_context: G2's context window plus the current STRUCTURAL_STATE value, restricted to applicability-audited variables (GRAMMAR_F2_APPLICABILITY.tsv / task85 section 8)
parameterization: one G2-family model per STRUCTURAL_STATE stratum, or a state-indexed mixture/back-off over a shared G2; state set frozen before fitting
training_algorithm: per-stratum (or mixture) fitting on DEVELOPMENT; stratum granularity and pooling/back-off policy selected on VALIDATION
hyperparameter_space: which STRUCTURAL_STATE variables are active; pooling/back-off strength across strata
generation_algorithm: sample TOKENs from the state-indexed G2, conditioned on a borrowed real STRUCTURAL_STATE skeleton (task85 section: generation protocol; the skeleton is never itself generated by Line A)
complexity_measure: sum of per-stratum G2 complexity + state-partition description cost (active-variable count x realized state count)
deterministic_seed_behavior: one PRNG stream, TOKEN-draw order, independent of the (fixed, not drawn) STRUCTURAL_STATE traversal order
failure_conditions: MEMORIZATION_DOMINATED (stratum count approaches per-LINE granularity with no pooling); COMPLEXITY_UNBOUNDED (all candidate variables activated without penalty)

name: Neural language model (auxiliary only)
inputs: same observables as the level it is used to audit
accessible_context: unrestricted (this is exactly why it cannot be primary, task85 section 19)
complexity_measure: NOT DEFINED as a comparison-eligible measure under GRAMMAR_COMPLEXITY_CONTRACT.md unless a prior, separate contract defines an interpretable complexity + generation + residual-accounting analogue
deterministic_seed_behavior: n/a until such a contract exists
failure_conditions: may be used only as a predictive upper-bound reference (task85 section 19); never eligible for G_min, never counted toward PRIMARY evidence (task85 section 56)
